name: Godrej Properties
step12_scaling_decision: Corporate real-estate developer under project-completion accounting - a generic 5-yr 3-statement template would model revenue recognition timing (project completion dates) that this engine cannot forecast reliably from public disclosures alone. Built instead: a code-based forward view (forward_model.py) deriving the debt path from the funding gap (capex/land spend + repayment - OCF), driven by the two variables that actually decide this rating per the Real Estate methodology - Booking Value growth and collections - base + stress case, cross-checked against ICRA own stated FY2027 debt guidance (Rs 18,500-19,000 cr) in its 21-Jul-2026 rationale. Plus the Step 12b scorecard filled from audited actuals. This mirrors the Vodafone Idea precedent (01-Sep-2026) for a business where the funding-gap arithmetic is the credit story, not a full P&L/BS/CF projection.
